inputs.name: litellm_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/berriai/litellm image, such as "v1.106.6". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for litellm_version, such as "sha256:37e2...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: db_connection_uri
inputs.description: PostgreSQL connection URI, such as "postgresql://litellm:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:5432/litellm". It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address LiteLLM listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: models
inputs.description: LiteLLM's model_list: the models clients can ask for, each with a model_name and litellm_params, such as [{ model_name = "gpt-4o", litellm_params = { model = "openai/gpt-4o", api_key = "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY" } }]. It's written to config.yaml as it is, so give keys as os.environ/NAME references to api_keys.

inputs.name: api_keys
inputs.description: Provider credentials and other secret environment variables for LiteLLM, such as { OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-...", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "sk-ant-..." }. Refer to each in models as os.environ/NAME. They go to a root-only env file on the host and never reach the plan or state.

inputs.name: log_prompts
inputs.description: Store each request's messages and the model's answer in LiteLLM's spend logs, in PostgreSQL, where admins can read them in the UI. Off by default: the logs then hold who called which model, when, with how many tokens and at what cost, but not what was said.

inputs.name: spend_logs
inputs.description: Write a row per request to LiteLLM's spend logs. Budgets and key spend are tracked either way; turning this off loses the per-request history.

inputs.name: default_key_budget
inputs.description: Budget in US dollars for a virtual key created without max_budget, such as 10. When null, such keys have no budget.

inputs.name: max_key_budget
inputs.description: Largest max_budget, in US dollars, that /key/generate accepts. A request for more is refused. When null, there's no limit.

inputs.name: budget_duration
inputs.description: How often a new key's budget resets when the request doesn't say, such as "30d" or "7d". When null, budgets don't reset.

inputs.name: fetch_model_prices
inputs.description: Fetch LiteLLM's model price list from GitHub each time it starts. When false, it uses the list in the image, which is as new as litellm_version.

inputs.name: general_settings
inputs.description: More of LiteLLM's general_settings, such as { allowed_routes = ["llm_api_routes"] }. Merged over the circuit's own at the top level. Written to the plan, state and config.yaml, so no secrets: use os.environ/NAME.

inputs.name: litellm_settings
inputs.description: More of LiteLLM's litellm_settings, such as { drop_params = false, success_callback = ["prometheus"] }. Merged over the circuit's own at the top level. Written to the plan, state and config.yaml, so no secrets.
